messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but most travelers find that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** strike the best balance between pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and more reasonable prices.

| What you want | Best months | Why |
|---------------|-------------|-----|
| **Mild, sunny weather** | April–May, September–October | Temperatures hover around 78–84 °F (25–29 °C). Rainfall is low, especially in the windward (eastern) parts of the islands. |
| **Low crowds & lower rates** | April–May, September–October | These months sit just outside the peak tourist seasons (winter holidays and summer vacation). Hotels and flights are typically cheaper, and popular spots (like Waikiki, Hanauma Bay, and Haleakala) are less crowded. |
| **Surf & beach conditions** | Late spring & early fall | The trade winds are steady, producing good surf on the North Shore of Oahu and the Big Island’s Kona coast. |
| **Wildlife & nature** | September–October | Whale watching off Maui and the Big Island peaks in late summer/early fall. |

### Quick comparison

| Season | Typical weather | Crowds | Prices |
|--------|-----------------|--------|--------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 70–80 °F (21–27 °C), higher rainfall | High (holiday travel) | High |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 78–84 °F (25–29 °C), low rainfall | Moderate | Moderate |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 80–88 °F (27–31 °C), occasional showers | High (school vacation) | High |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | 78–84 °F (25–29 °C), low rainfall | Low | Low |

### Bottom line

If you’re looking for a blend of great weather, fewer crowds, and better deals, aim for **late April through early May or late August through early October**. If you’re okay with higher prices and crowds, the winter holidays are the most popular time, especially for families. If you’re a surfer, the North Shore’s big‑wave season peaks in late summer/early fall, so that’s a good time for surf‑focused trips.

We can provide general knowledge: best months are April, May, September, October. Provide reasons: good weather, lower crowds, lower prices. Also mention that December and January are peak season.
